target.title: fix: restore tooling CI after transcript test addition
target.body:
Related: #98493

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an operational issue where the `checks-node-core-tooling` main CI job failed after #98493 added a transcript-store test that imports `test/helpers/temp-dir.ts`. The routing code correctly discovered the new importer, but the exact routing expectation did not include it.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `src/transcripts/store.test.ts` to the expected default-unit routing plan for the shared temp-dir helper. This keeps the import-graph implementation and exact equality assertion intact; it does not weaken or bypass the routing test.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior changes. Maintainers regain a green tooling shard on `main`, while test-helper changes continue to route to every importing test.

## Evidence

- Regression provenance: #98493 was authored by @wangmiao0668000666 and merged by @vincentkoc as commit `94cb14b97ead60878056fd3f1d01545b6acca63a`.
- Exact failed main CI: [run 28515484950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28515484950), [job 84526443533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28515484950/job/84526443533), at SHA `94cb14b97ead60878056fd3f1d01545b6acca63a`: 4,464 tests passed and the sole failure was `src/scripts/test-projects.test.ts:857`, whose received unit plan additionally contained `src/transcripts/store.test.ts`.
- Current-main reproduction: at `4dcd95d1bcefbd832b3ae8c3bbf180f221b519ef`, `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/scripts/test-projects.test.ts` reproduced the single failure (82 passed, 1 failed).
- Focused fixed proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/scripts/test-projects.test.ts` passed all 83 tests.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox: provider `blacksmith-testbox`, lease `tbx_01kwesad6v7qkygn3743vf2vgz`, wrapper exit `0`. Path-scoped `check:changed` passed core test typecheck and lint. The exact `test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts` shard passed 280 files and 4,465 tests, with 15 skipped, in 267.20 seconds.
- Autoreview: `gpt-5.6-sol`, xhigh, clean with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Pure test-routing expectation repair; there is no external runtime/live boundary to exercise.
